summary: casecheck's self-test lines of a workload's suspensions, each fault in a private copy of cases.c or of the case schema found by its own line

argv: ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/include -I utils tools/etude/casecheck.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/cases.c tools/etude/digest.c tools/etude/judge.c tools/etude/json.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/schema.c tools/etude/verdict.c tools/etude/history.c tools/etude/history_json.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/casecheck && mkdir -p ${WORK}/schemas && cp tools/etude/schemas/*.json ${WORK}/schemas/ && cp ${SRC}/tools/etude/schemas/case.schema.json ${WORK}/schemas/case.schema.json

d=$TMPDIR/selftest && mkdir -p $d/fixtures && cp tools/etude/fixtures/suspend.json tools/etude/fixtures/rules.json $d/fixtures/ && grep -F -e ' ./suspend.json' -e '| suspend-' tools/etude/fixtures/expect > $d/fixtures/expect && ln -s ${WORK}/schemas $d/schemas && ${WORK}/casecheck --selftest $d/fixtures; s=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $s

faults.name: machine
faults.summary: a suspension of a machine the case does not declare is not reported

lines: | suspend-machine: the suspension stalls stops elsewhere

faults.name: witness
faults.summary: a suspension that counts its stops on a witness of another kind is not reported

lines: | suspend-witness: the suspension stalls counts its stops on stage

faults.name: limit
faults.summary: a suspension of more cycles than its witness's limit is not reported

lines: | suspend-limit: the suspension stalls has 30 cycles

faults.name: twice
faults.summary: a suspension declared twice is not reported

lines: | suspend-twice: the suspension stalls is declared twice

faults.name: shared
faults.summary: two suspensions that count their stops on one witness are not reported

lines: | suspend-shared: the witness stops counts the stops of two suspensions

faults.name: undeclared
faults.summary: the schema takes no suspensions in a workload
